quarterly_data.quarter: Delta Electronics press release: Delta Electronics' Consolidated Sales Revenues for July (08-10-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Delta Electronics reported unaudited consolidated sales revenues for July 2026 of NT$67,073 million, a 47.7 percent increase from NT$45,397 million in July 2025 and a 2.2 percent increase from NT$65,603 million in June 2026. Cumulative January-July 2026 consolidated sales revenues were NT$409,682 million, a 42.1 percent increase from NT$288,352 million in the same period of 2025. July 2026 sales mix: Power Electronics 57%, Infrastructure 32%, Automation 7%, Mobility 4%.
quarterly_data.figure: July 2026 NT$67,073 million (+47.7% YoY, +2.2% MoM); Jan-Jul 2026 NT$409,682 million (+42.1% YoY); Power Electronics 57%, Infrastructure 32%, Automation 7%, Mobility 4%
